verdict.rationale: The evidence pack has no migration tool or documented way to move files and settings from an old computer to a new Fedora Workstation install. The closest item, online accounts (fedora-docs-9), brings cloud calendar, contacts and data onto the desktop. That is account sync, not a transfer of local files and settings from another machine. The version-upgrade claim (fedora-docs-15) concerns in-place OS upgrades, not machine-to-machine migration.
